verse.verse_1: By the night when it envelopeth,
verse.verse_2: By the day when it appeareth in glory,
verse.verse_3: By Him Who hath created the male and the female,
verse.verse_5: Then as for him who giveths and feareth Him.
verse.verse_7: Unto him therefore We shall indeed make easy the path to ease.
verse.verse_8: And as for him who stinteth and is heedless,
verse.verse_10: Unto him therefore We shall Indeed make easy the path to hardship.
verse.verse_11: And his substance will avail him not when he perisheth.
verse.verse_12: Verify on us is the guidance
verse.verse_13: And verify Ours is both the Hereafter and the life present.
verse.verse_14: Wherefore have warned you of Fire flaming,
verse.verse_15: None shall roast therein but the most wretched,
verse.verse_17: And avoid it shall the most pious,
verse.verse_18: Who giveth away his substance that he may be cleansed,
verse.verse_19: And who hath no favour from anyone to recompense.
verse.verse_20: But only seeking the Countenance of his Lord the Most High.
verse.verse_21: And presently he shall become wellpleased.
